purpose: Teach: 伏線/転機/崇/施す/骨太/通り抜け/ろくな/根付い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時の伏線、今、結果として現れているな。
lines.en: The seeds planted when we started the company—they're bearing fruit now.
lines.style: Measured, observational. Slight pause before the dash. Thoughtful tone, eyes distant. The voice of someone connecting past to present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会社の転機、創業者がよく語っていました。
lines.en: Yes. The founder always talked about moments like this—turning points for the company.
lines.style: Attentive, meeting his gaze directly. Steady pace. A note of respect in 'founder' without sounding reverent. Grounded, professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者を崇拝する社員も、いるな、未だに。
lines.en: There are still staff who hold the founder almost sacred.
lines.style: Calm observation, neither approving nor dismissing. Light, knowing tone—a leader who's seen this before. Slight tilt of the head.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人研修に新手法を施す予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to introduce a new approach to the new-hire training.
lines.style: Offering information clearly, without overstepping. Alert, focused. A slight lean forward—eager to show progress without presuming approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 骨太の経営方針、社是として残せ。
lines.en: Keep the core of our management philosophy. Let it stay in our company DNA.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Weight on 'keep.' Measured tempo. The voice of someone passing something forward. Eyes steady on his subordinate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。困難な時期を通り抜けて、強くなりました。
lines.en: Yes. We've gone through difficult years and come out stronger for it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A slight nod mid-sentence. Pride held in check. The confidence of someone who lived through it, not boasting about it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ろくな結果が出ない期間、こちらの体力次第だ。
lines.en: The periods when results stall—those test our staying power.
lines.style: Measured, grave. Slight pause before the second clause. The voice of experience. Not ominous, but serious. Looking through rather than at.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。企業文化が根付いていく過程、大事にします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be mindful of how the company culture takes root. That matters.
lines.style: Sincere closing note. Slower pace on the final sentence. Meeting his intent, not just his words. A trace of gravity—understanding the weight of what's being asked.
